about.title: Hum honey ko easy bana rahe hain
about.text: Bahut se log honey isliye use nahi karte kyunki use karna aasaan nahi hota: jar chipchipa, chammach alag, carry karna mushkil. HoneyKey is problem ko solve karta hai: har pack mein ready spoon, perfect 7 g honey, aur sealed freshness.

points.t: Naye packs aur designs aane wale hain

founder.name: Founder ka naam

founder.quote: Honey sabke liye easy hona chahiye.
